feeding_claim.verbatim: dedicated to raising 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef, lamb, and pasture-raised pork

notes: Family farm on the Hamakua Coast of the Big Island. Free pickup at the farm in Honomu by appointment. Ships by FedEx within Hawaii (Big Island, Oahu, Maui, Kauai, Molokai, and a Molokai and Lanai page), no mainland shipping; shipping starts at 20 pounds. Beef shares of 1/16, 1/8, 1/4 and 1/2. Chicken and eggs are labeled pasture raised but no feed details were found. Site menu also lists goat and rabbit, but no goat products showed on the pages read. Also sells wild caught fish and ghee whose source is not stated, so they are left out. A CSA subscription section is listed but was not checked. No phone, email or street address on the site.
